title: The numbered agenda on its own words

members.role: the page-species form of the test card's numbered rows, staggered by kinetics:stagger
one glyph per named thing, crossed out later (Bravos' rhyme)
the stressed caption word underlined on the badge/row beat
the second chip lands on its own named thing, on the same stagger

does: The promise is enumerated on the page itself: two to four numbered rows arrive one per spoken clause, a glyph chip lands for each named thing, and the stressed word is underlined as it is said.
